scope: Post-run limitation found by independent code review; this file does not alter or overwrite the frozen manifest or decision lock.

supplemental_start_receipt_chain.relationship_to_frozen_manifests: Supplemental provenance only; the already-written manifests were not modified.

withdrawn_metric_claim.reason: The V18 signal-level implementation subtracts TO confirmation from the next HS onset but does not scan the intervening toe latch for reactivation. It is not equivalent to the V14/V17 causal toe-clear gate.

data_access_clarification.trial_08_interpretation: internal procedural holdout only; not scientifically virgin before V18

platform_and_io_limitations.atomic_no_clobber: Top-level run-directory creation is exclusive; per-file temporary-write plus os.replace is not a race-proof no-clobber primitive against an adversarial concurrent writer.
platform_and_io_limitations.pure_python_import: The evaluator imports the OpenSim-backed V15 acquisition lineage eagerly and therefore requires the project environment even for pure signal tests.

exactly_compared: armed, stance and clear-since state digest
signal_engine_parity_scope.effect_on_terminal_decision: none; event and edge outputs are exactly equal and every semantic independently fails count or HS timing in each consumption result

t0_scope.offline_engine: Initializes latch state from the t0 load without emitting an event.
t0_scope.runtime_difference: The runtime does not deliver the t0 sample and begins with latches OFF before resolving startup/bootstrap.
t0_scope.independent_check: A runtime-style latch-OFF replay produced the same HS/TO journals on trials 02 and 04; differences were limited to initial edge/bootstrap state outside all scored views.
